# Grid-Based Logic Games Taxonomy

## 1. Number Placement & Constraint Games
*Games where digits/numbers must be placed according to rules*
- Sudoku
- Ripple Effect
- Makaro
- Nansuke
- Juosan

## 2. Region Division & Partitioning Games
*Games where the grid must be divided into defined regions or shapes*
- Fillomino
- Shikaku
- Five Cells
- Double Choco
- Evolomino
- Nuritwin
- LITS
- Norinori
- Chained Block

## 3. Path & Loop Drawing Games
*Games where continuous paths or closed loops must be drawn*
- Slitherlink
- Masyu
- Numberlink
- Hebi
- Nagareru
- Suraromu
- Mid-loop
- Moon-or-Sun
- Dotchi-Loop
- Pencils

## 4. Shading & Painting Games
*Games where cells must be selectively shaded or colored*
- Nurikabe
- Heyawake
- Hitori
- Kurodoko
- Tilepaint
- Nurimeizu
- Choco Banana
- Kurotto
- Usowan

## 5. Light & Visibility Games
*Games based on line-of-sight, illumination, or directional visibility*
- Akari
- Yajilin
- Nurimisaki
- Shakashaka

## 6. Object Placement & Movement Games
*Games involving placing or moving objects within the grid*
- Yosenabe
- Satogaeri
- Sto-stone
- Sashigane

## 7. Arrow & Direction Constraint Games
*Games governed primarily by directional indicators or flow*
- Hashiwokakero
- Juosan *(moved — see note)*
- Mid-loop *(moved — see note)*

---
> **Note:** Each game appears exactly once. A small number of games sit at category boundaries; final placement reflects their most dominant mechanic.

---

**Final clean single-placement list confirms all 42 games are included exactly once across 7 categories.**
